messages.content: 案件編號XY1234在Los Angeles County Court和案件編號GH5678在Orange County Court的狀態和預定審判日期是什麼？

function.name: court_info_get_case_status
function.description: Retrieves the status and trial dates for court cases from specified county courts. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

court.description: The county court where the case is filed.

details.description: Specific details required about the court case. Defaults to 'status'.

message.reasoning:
We need to call the function court_info_get_case_status twice: once for XY1234 in Los Angeles County Court, and once for GH5678 in Orange County Court. We need both status and trial_date. The function signature says details can be "status" or "trial_date". But we want both. Possibly we need to call twice per case? Or maybe we can pass details as "status" and then again "trial_date"? The function expects a single details value. So we might need to call twice per case. But the user asked for status and trial date for each case. So we should call twice per case.

Thus first call: case_number="XY1234", court="Los Angeles County Court", details="status". Then second call: same case_number, court, details="trial_date". Then third call: case_number="GH5678", court="Orange County Court", details="status". Fourth call: same case_number, court, details="trial_date".

But maybe the function can handle multiple details? It says defaults to 'status', but not sure if it accepts array. Probably not. So we do four calls.
